coordinateSystem.targetWidth: Normalized to 1.0 unit. Target height depends on image aspect ratio.
coordinateSystem.position: [x, y, z] in target units. x: -0.5 (left) to +0.5 (right). y: -0.5 (bottom) to +0.5 (top). z: 0 (flush with surface) to +0.5 (floating in front toward camera).
coordinateSystem.rotation: [x, y, z] in degrees. e.g., [0, 0, 0] = upright facing camera. [90, 0, 0] = tilted flat.
coordinateSystem.scale: Number or [sx, sy, sz]. e.g., 0.5 scales the item to half the target width.

model.description: 3D GLTF/GLB model placed in AR space.
model.notes: src must start with /content/assets/... animation can be 'auto' (plays first animation clip) or a specific clip name.

video.description: MP4 video streamed on an augmented 3D plane.
video.notes: src must point to an H.264 MP4 with +faststart. poster is an optional WebP/PNG thumbnail shown while loading. loop defaults to true.

image.description: 2D image overlay (badge, sticker, or logo) preserving aspect ratio.
image.notes: src can be WebP, PNG, or JPG.

text.description: Crisp dynamic text banner rendered on a canvas texture.
text.notes: color is a hex code (e.g. #38bdf8). width is relative to target width (e.g. 0.8).

infoCard.description: Bottom DOM overlay card shown when target is locked.
infoCard.notes: Displays title and brief explanation. Clean presentation without external links.

infoCard.heading: Experience Heading
infoCard.body: A short 1-2 sentence description shown in the bottom card.
